从市局大楼出来，顾承安骑上电驴，没急着回去。

反正闲着也是闲着，不如继续当移动数据采集站。

天珠的有效范围就十米，想要覆盖更多区域，唯一的办法就是人肉巡航。

沿着深南大道一路往西，经过市民中心、会展中心，再拐进华强北。

华强北永远是人挤人。电子市场门口拉客的、举着手机壳样品的、推着小推车送货的，各种口音混在一起，比菜市场还热闹。顾承安把车速降到最低，慢慢从人流中穿过去。

出了华强北，他又绕到东门老街、国贸、蔡屋围，兜了一大圈。

等他在路边停下来歇脚的时候，看了一眼天珠APP——又是三千多条数据。

顾承安揉了揉眼睛，头皮发麻。

三千多条，一条一条翻，按照昨晚的速度，少说得看一个半小时。关键是绝大多数都是普通人的普通信息，真正有价值的可能就那么几条，全靠肉眼筛。

这效率，属实感人。

照这个干法，眼睛迟早得交代在这上面。

近视都是轻的，搞不好直接散光加飞蚊症套餐，一个变成俩。

他突然想到一个事。

把车靠边停稳，掏出手机，打开某东APP。

在搜索栏里输入“天珠项链同款”，翻了几页，找到一个和他脖子上戴的天珠几乎一模一样的款式。

九十八块，包邮，明天就到。

多一个备用，关键时刻有用

下完单，他又搜了“微型记录仪”。

挑了个某知名品牌拇指大小的高清款，磁吸式，可以别在衣领上，续航六小时，1999块，东西是真不错，就是真TM不便宜。

以后遇到关键场景，口说无凭，有影像资料在手，都比干巴巴地描述强一百倍。

两单下完，他看了眼余额。

-7899元。

没错，又用花呗了。

不怕，奖金今天就到。

他把手机揣回兜里，继续骑车闲逛。

下午一点多。

顾承安正在龙华区一家沙县小吃里嗦粉，手机震了一下。

看了下，是银行的短信提醒。

他放下筷子，有点期待的点开。

【尾号9527账户于6月20日14:15收到XX公安局转账200,000.00元，余额200007.52元。】

顾承安盯着这个数字看了三秒。

说不激动是假的，上一世他干了那么多年，工资从来没有一次性到账过这么大一笔。但激动归激动，两世加起来五十多年的人生阅历摆在那儿，不至于为了二十万原地起飞。

钱这东西，够用就行。

不够的时候愁，够了以后——还是愁，愁怎么花。

他深吸一口气，放下手机，先把最后几口粉嗦完，擦了擦嘴。

然后掏出手机，以迅雷不及掩耳之势打开某付宝。

花呗。

After coming out of the city bureau building, Gu Chengan got on the electric donkey and was in no hurry to go back.

Anyway, idle time is idle, so it is better to continue to be a mobile data collection station.

The effective range of the Dzi Bead is only ten meters. If you want to cover more areas, the only way is to cruise with human flesh.

Go west along Shennan Avenue, pass the Civic Center and the Convention and Exhibition Center, and then turn into Huaqiang North.

Huaqiangbei is always crowded.The people soliciting customers at the entrance of the electronics market, holding samples of mobile phone cases, and people pushing carts to deliver goods all mixed together with various accents, making it more lively than the vegetable market.Gu Chengan reduced the speed to a minimum and slowly passed through the crowd.

After leaving Huaqiangbei, he went around Dongmen Old Street, Guomao and Caiwuwei, making a long circle.

When he stopped to rest on the side of the road, he took a look at the Tianzhu APP - there were more than 3,000 pieces of data.

Gu Chengan rubbed his eyes, his scalp numb.

There are more than 3,000 articles, one by one. According to the speed last night, it would take at least an hour and a half to read.The key is that the vast majority of it is ordinary information for ordinary people, and there may only be a few pieces of real value, all of which rely on the naked eye.

This efficiency is truly impressive.

If you follow this approach, your eyes will have to settle on it sooner or later.

Myopia is usually mild, so maybe just add astigmatism and floaters as a package, and one becomes two.

Something suddenly occurred to him.

He pulled over the car, took out his mobile phone, and opened the Moudong APP.

He entered "same style of Dzi beads necklace" in the search bar, flipped through a few pages, and found a style that was almost identical to the Dzi beads he wore around his neck.

Ninety-eight yuan, free shipping, will arrive tomorrow.

One more backup, useful at critical moments

After placing the order, he searched for "micro recorder".

I chose a thumb-sized high-definition model from a well-known brand. It is magnetic and can be pinned to the collar. It has a battery life of six hours and costs 1999 yuan. It is really good, but it is really not cheap.

In the future, when encountering key scenes, it is a hundred times better to talk about it with no evidence and have video data in hand than to describe it dryly.

After placing two orders, he looked at the balance.

-7899 yuan.

That’s right, I’m using Huabei again.

Don’t be afraid, the bonus will arrive today.

He put his phone back in his pocket and continued to stroll around on his bike.

It's about one o'clock in the afternoon.

Gu Chengan was sipping noodles at a Shaxian snack in Longhua District when his phone vibrated.

I looked at it and saw it was a text message reminder from the bank.

He put down his chopsticks and clicked them expectantly.

[Account with tail number 9527 received a transfer of 200,000.00 yuan from the XX Public Security Bureau at 14:15 on June 20, with a balance of 200,007.52 yuan.】

Gu Chengan stared at the number for three seconds.

It would be a lie to say he wasn't excited. He had worked for so many years in his previous life, and his salary had never been paid in such a large amount at once.But I am excited. With more than 50 years of life experience in my two lives, I will not take off just for 200,000 yuan.

Money is just enough.

When there is not enough, you are worried. After you have enough - you are still worried about how to spend it.

He took a deep breath, put down his phone, finished the last few puffs of powder, and wiped his mouth.

Then he took out his mobile phone and opened a certain Alipay with lightning speed.

Huabei.
